featured.titleEn: Pokopia Chronicles: Rebuilding a World Abandoned by Humanity
featured.titleZh: Pokopia 年代記：在人類遺棄的世界中重建生態
featured.excerptEn: Step into the role of Ditto in a post-apocalyptic Kanto region. As humanity fled to space, you awaken alone with a Pokédex guided by Professor Tangrowth — tasked with restoring five devastated ecosystems and reuniting over 300 Pokémon species with the land they once called home.
featured.excerptZh: 在末世後的關都地區扮演百變怪。人類移居太空後，你在巨蔓藤博士的帶領下，手持圖鑑從荒蕪中甦醒，踏上復育五大生態區域、重新召喚散落世間寶可夢的旅程。
featured.author: Prof. Tangrowth
